name: Rainy Window
description: Simulates rain on a window that distorts the view. Use the mouse to wipe the glass clean.

name: Ink Marbling
description: Persistent pigment and thickness marbling with exact-load advection, plasma turbulence, sprung stirring, bounded click ink drops, ACES output, and source-depth pass-through.

name: Kimi Liquid Glass
description: Realistic liquid surface with caustics, chromatic refraction, and specular highlights.

name: Liquid Displacement
description: Eulerian fluid displacement: semi-Lagrangian advection, FFT-banded turbulence injection and a LOCAL JACOBI pressure projection that relaxes the centre and its four neighbours against a frozen ring, so the iteration slider now controls real convergence (it previously re-read the same unchanging neighbours every sweep). The smoothed pointer and its velocity live in extraBuffer[133..136]; clicks inject bounded divergence impulses. dataTextureA carries simulation state, not display colour.

updatedParams.name: Viscosity
updatedParams.description: Laplacian velocity diffusion; also scales the displacement amplitude.

updatedParams.name: Pressure Iterations
updatedParams.description: Local Jacobi sweeps, 1-20. Genuinely convergent as of Batch 58B — the previous loop recomputed an identical value every iteration.

updatedParams.name: Flow Speed
updatedParams.description: Advection timestep multiplier; bass adds up to +40%.

updatedParams.name: Turbidity
updatedParams.description: Gain on the eight FFT-banded curl cells and on Beer-Lambert absorption.

name: Liquid Fast
description: Fast analytical liquid ripples with low-sample motion blur, depth-aware flow, audio acceleration, and spectral edge highlights.

name: Liquid Glitch
description: Block-quantized liquid smearing with audio-reactive signal corruption, chromatic splitting, click bursts, and temporal datamosh trails.

params.name: Flow Corruption
params.description: Liquid smear and signal corruption intensity

name: Liquid Jelly
description: Spring-damped jelly deformation with subsurface scattering, audio-responsive elasticity, depth masking, and temporal wobble trails.

name: Liquid Metal
description: Liquid metal with the Rosensweig instability: above a critical field set by the surface-tension/gravity balance, the flat surface breaks into a hexagonal lattice of standing peaks whose amplitude saturates as the square root of the supercritical excess — the actual mechanism behind ferrofluid spikes. Shading uses an anisotropic Ward-style lobe stretched perpendicular to the flow with FFT-banded anisotropy. Height state stays in dataTextureA; reads move to exact textureLoad and the output gains ACES.

updatedParams.name: Viscosity
updatedParams.description: Surface relaxation rate; also raises the critical field for spiking.

updatedParams.name: Reflectivity
updatedParams.description: Metallic reflectance and specular tightness.

updatedParams.name: Chromatic Spread
updatedParams.description: Channel split through the refracted surface.

updatedParams.name: Flow Speed
updatedParams.description: Rate the height field drains along the depth gradient.

name: Liquid Mirror
description: Metallic liquid surface that reflects the image and ripples under the mouse.

name: Liquid Optimized (Pass 1)
description: Physics simulation pass: capillary wave dynamics, Laplace pressure, ripple propagation, and ambient micro-ripples. Outputs height field state to dataTextureA.

name: Liquid Surface Tension (Optimized)
description: Capillary surface tension with an ANALYTIC height gradient: the field is evaluated once and its exact derivative accumulated in the same loop, replacing five full evaluations (up to 250 ripple iterations per pixel) with one. The saved budget buys an eight-train FFT capillary spectrum with dispersion-correct phase speeds and Fresnel-weighted Beer-Lambert absorption along the true slant path.

updatedParams.name: Surface Tension
updatedParams.description: Height scale and refraction strength of the film.

updatedParams.name: Gravity Scale
updatedParams.description: Wavenumber and phase speed of the click ripple packets.

updatedParams.name: Damping
updatedParams.description: Ripple packet amplitude retention.

updatedParams.name: Turbidity
updatedParams.description: Absorption path multiplier; also dulls the specular.

name: Liquid (Pass 1)
description: Capillary wave physics pass: surface tension simulation with Laplacian and biharmonic operators, gravity waves, ripple sources, and ambient micro-ripples. Outputs persistent height field to dataTextureA.

name: Liquid Perspective
description: Depth-aware liquid perspective warp with silhouette-safe parallax, canonical mouse interaction, audio-reactive ripples, and bioluminescent edges.

params.name: Density
params.description: Spatial frequency of the perspective flow

name: Liquid Rainbow Prismatic
description: Liquid Rainbow Prismatic

name: Liquid Rainbow
description: Spectral Gerstner sea: eight trochoidal wave trains, one per FFT bin, fanned across a spreading angle with deep-water dispersion (omega = sqrt(g*k)) so swells and chop travel at different speeds. Thin-film interference, chromatic dispersion and a spring-damped pointer whose stroke direction shears the surface.

params.name: Viscosity
params.description: Flow damping and spectral film thickness

updatedParams.name: Viscosity
updatedParams.description: Damps the wave displacement and tightens the pointer drag core.

updatedParams.name: Turbulence
updatedParams.description: Wavenumber multiplier across the spectrum and drag gain.

updatedParams.name: Ripple Strength
updatedParams.description: Amplitude of the bounded click shockwaves.

updatedParams.name: Dispersion
updatedParams.description: Thin-film phase offset and chromatic channel spread.

name: Liquid RGB
description: Viscous RGB refraction with wavelength-dependent absorption, audio-reactive caustic fringes, and depth-sensitive channel separation.

name: Liquid Smear
description: Pigment drag along the pointer's real travel direction, taken from a spring-damped cursor and its velocity in extraBuffer[133..136] — the previous version always pulled toward the cursor centre, which reads as a sink rather than a brush. A five-tap kernel bleeds pigment along the stroke normal with a width set by the local FFT bin. History is fetched with exact textureLoad, bilinear by hand.

updatedParams.name: Smear Strength
updatedParams.description: Drag length along the pointer stroke.

updatedParams.name: Brush Size
updatedParams.description: Radius of the drag falloff around the cursor.

updatedParams.name: Persistence
updatedParams.description: How much of the smeared field survives each frame.

updatedParams.name: Mix Strength
updatedParams.description: Blend of the smeared field over the live plate.

name: Liquid Tensor Vortex
description: A 3D tensor field that melts and reforms like liquid metal under mouse vorticity, with bass-driven surface tension and transmission alpha that lets the background breathe through the folds.

name: Liquid Viscous Nebula grokcf1
description: Cosmic viscous flow with multi-octave nebula warping, emissive veins, depth parallax, audio reactivity, and persistent trails.

name: Liquid Viscous (Simple)
description: Viscous laminar flow with cohesive smoothing, audio-reactive click vortices, depth-aware motion, and subtle spectral film.

name: Liquid Viscous
description: 2D incompressible Navier-Stokes with vorticity confinement. Vorticity at the centre and its four neighbours now comes from ONE shared stencil (was five separate calls, each doing four filtered samples), the pressure solve genuinely relaxes instead of recomputing one value four times, and the audio vortices drift along continuous Lissajous paths instead of teleporting every 0.7 s. Dye is injected per FFT band. dataTextureA carries simulation state.

updatedParams.name: Viscosity
updatedParams.description: Velocity damping and dye dissipation rate.

updatedParams.name: Vorticity Confinement
updatedParams.description: Strength of the confinement force that keeps eddies from smearing out (maps to zoom_params.y).

updatedParams.name: Turbulence Injection
updatedParams.description: Gain on the three-octave cascade and the per-band dye emitters (maps to zoom_params.z).

updatedParams.name: Hue Shift
updatedParams.description: Rotates the dye/vorticity hue mapping (maps to zoom_params.w).

name: Liquid Zoom
description: Endless zoom-through built from four phase-offset parallax layers composited back-to-front by scene depth, each owning two FFT bins so the stack pulses through the spectrum. Replaces the previous two-layer version whose depth write picked a dominant layer with a hard threshold that popped on every crossing. Clicks emit bounded zoom pulses.

updatedParams.name: Near Layer Speed
updatedParams.description: Zoom cadence for near (low-depth) pixels — maps to zoom_params.x.

updatedParams.name: Far Layer Speed
updatedParams.description: Zoom cadence for far (high-depth) pixels — maps to zoom_params.y.

updatedParams.name: Parallax Strength
updatedParams.description: Exponent shaping the depth-to-speed curve — maps to zoom_params.z.

updatedParams.name: Fog Density
updatedParams.description: Distance fog applied to far layers — maps to zoom_params.w.

description: Downward luma-driven melt with exact advected history, held-pointer heat, rapid melt and drip packets, three-band audio response, and bounded click fronts.
name: Luma Melt
Luma Velocity Melt
description: Image melts downwards with curl-noise turbulence. Bright pixels drip faster; chromatic separation makes R/B channels drip at different rates. Audio heat pulses and depth viscosity modulate flow.

name: Rain Ripples
description: Interactive water ripples and raindrops with FBM micro-ripples, depth-aware fog, displacement-driven chromatic aberration, specular highlights, and ACES tone mapping.

params.name: Intensity
params.description: Overall ripple displacement and depth-fog influence

params.name: Detail
params.description: Wave sharpness and chromatic aberration amount

name: Viscous Drag
description: A stylized thick-liquid warp with directionally advected RG offset state, traveling vortex packets, mouse-pressure smears, and click-launched pressure fronts. Depth is passed through unchanged.
